title: Helping Our Neighbours
text:
In many cities, people do not have enough money for food. Some families must choose between buying groceries and paying rent. Many local groups try to help them. They collect food and give it to people every week.

Volunteers say that the problem is growing. Some workers have low salaries, so they need extra help. Schools also help by giving free lunches to children. Many people say that everyone should work together to solve this problem.

questions.text: What must some families choose between?
What do schools give to children?
Why do some workers need extra help?
options: They do not like their jobs.
They live far from the city.

questions.text: What is the writer's main purpose?
options: to sell food in the city
to encourage people to work together

vocabulary.definition: food and everyday items bought in a shop
people who help others without being paid
money that a person receives for their work each month
money paid regularly to live in a house or flat

paragraph_translations: Em muitas cidades, as pessoas não têm dinheiro suficiente para comida. Algumas famílias precisam escolher entre comprar mantimentos e pagar o aluguel. Muitos grupos locais tentam ajudá-las. Eles recolhem alimentos e os entregam às pessoas toda semana.

Os voluntários dizem que o problema está crescendo. Alguns trabalhadores têm salários baixos, por isso precisam de ajuda extra. As escolas também ajudam dando almoço gratuito às crianças. Muitas pessoas dizem que todos devem trabalhar juntos para resolver este problema.
